summary: Reject incomplete adoption before writes and report missing prerequisites

delivery.outcome: Reject incomplete governance adoption before any target writes, including unchanged installs and upgrades. Publish the tested source change through independent review.
nonGoals: No history rewrite or weakening of independent publication.
No migration of target-owned documentation or test frameworks.

architecture.decision: Reuse the complete planned prerequisite list as a pre-write failure gate; make check mode account for prerequisites even with no payload drift.
interfaceChanges: Incomplete adoption returns a failure status before writing target files.
architecture.rollback: Revert via independently reviewed follow-up if a caller requires a separately defined preparation operation.

validation.evidence: Regression for no-write refusal, unchanged incomplete installation, preserved existing content and successful retry after prerequisites are supplied.
